# cedoscript-claude

> Claude Code plugin for writing CedoScript, the JavaScript scripting of the Tenacity Minecraft client.

- [Skill](skills/cedoscript/SKILL.md): how to write scripts
- [API reference](skills/cedoscript/reference/cedoscript.d.ts): every global, event and object
- [Capabilities](skills/cedoscript/reference/capabilities.json)
- [Example](skills/cedoscript/examples/target-hud.js)
- [Checker](skills/cedoscript/scripts/check-script.mjs)
- [Scripting docs](https://tenacity.rip/docs)
